meta.title: feat: implement async notification and telemetry system (Phase 1-3)
meta.body_summary: Phase 1-3 of async notification/telemetry system: introduces a non-blocking event bus with error deduplication and adapter-based integration, preventing blocking operations during error handling.

perf_labels.notes: Large multi-packag async infrastructure refactor; merged after addressing bot-flagged code quality issues, but no benchmark evidence for performance claims.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2217 changed lines across 22 files, this is a large-scale infrastructure refactor by absolute volume. It fits a phased architectural performance PR that merged after addressing automated code review feedback, consistent with a maintainer-driven iterative merge.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit bot flagged a typo in interface method name (SupportsRatching→SupportsBatching), pointer-to-interface anti-pattern in atomic storage, use of interface{} instead of any, time.Sleep in tests instead of deterministic synchronization, missing t.Parallel, and suboptimal LRU implementation; all were addressed in follow-up commit ebf22bad.
review_details.performance_claim: Non-blocking error event bus reduces latency with <100ns overhead when disabled, O(1) deduplication with <100ns overhead, and non-blocking publish.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-package async infrastructure with adapter pattern and deduplication is within agent capability when the maintainer accepts automated review feedback; the agent produced working code but required style and best-practice fixes from a bot review.

detection_detail.code_reading: CodeRabbit bot performed static analysis and flagged multiple code quality and style issues; maintainer addressed them before merging.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance benchmarks; only narrative claims of sub-100ns overhead and O(1) deduplication without measurements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After bot review, a follow-up commit (ebf22bad) fixed typo, anti-pattern, test synchronization, and added CLAUDE.md documentation.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced async event bus (TryPublish), error deduplication with LRU cache, and adapter pattern to integrate errors package without circular dependencies; added comprehensive tests and updated error category type to string.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn is from new test files and code quality follow-up; production logic is concentrated in a few core files.
change_trajectory: Initial event bus and test suite implemented.
Error deduplication layer added with LRU cache.
Integration of errors package via adapter pattern, circular-dependency safe.
Cross-package API update for GetCategory() string return type.
Bot review feedback incorporated: typo, anti-pattern, time.Sleep replacement, t.Parallel, CLAUDE.md lessons added.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit posted a detailed walkthrough and 18 actionable inline comments, no CHANGES_REQUESTED.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer addressed suggestions in commit ebf22bad.

review_signals.summary: Method name SupportsRatching should be SupportsBatching; fixed in follow-up commit.
Pointer-to-interface anti-pattern in atomic storage; refactored to atomic.Value.
review_signals.action_taken: Replaced atomic.Pointer with atomic.Value in eventbus_integration.go.

review_signals.summary: Replace interface{} with any; addressed in ebf22bad.
review_signals.action_taken: Updated EventPublisher interface and related code.

review_signals.summary: Add t.Parallel() and replace time.Sleep with deterministic sync; implemented in tests.
review_signals.action_taken: Multiple test files updated for parallel execution and wait‑for‑processed helpers.

review_signals.summary: LRU eviction uses O(n) linear search; suggested more efficient library or linked‑list approach (non‑blocking).
Acknowledged fixing linter issues caused by GetCategory() API change and that all tests pass.
